fields.description: Issue includes editorials and satire on Miami municipal politics and an upcoming election, criticism of Florida Power & Light and city bus contract finances, and commentary advocating a division between “New Florida” and “Old Florida.” Coverage also includes the Dade County Fair, foreclosure sales, prohibition enforcement anecdotes, and a humorous feature on “Hammerhead Greeby” and utility meter-reading, along with local notices and advertisements.
